# Original evergreen art provenance

Status: the fourth original art candidate passed source-bundle, editable Blender
source/export, and isolated Godot import/capture checks and received bounded
visual acceptance as a faceted prototype source artifact. This is asset-source
acceptance only. It establishes no current-game placement, runtime performance,
geographic vegetation, surveyed obstacle, or aviation fidelity claim. See
[the path-redacted art evidence](../../../docs/evidence/P4/original-evergreens.md)
for retained observations and limits.

The original procedural designs and code were authored for Flight Simulator
contributors in 2026 for #252. Inputs are explicit source parameters/seeds,
mathematical geometry, the checked original-evergreens-v1 brief, and the fixed
project MIT notice. No acquired or traced photograph, mesh, texture, species
dataset, external art, or generated raster imagery is used. The silhouettes are
PNW-inspired decorative studies, without botanical or site accuracy claims.

Rights for original geometry, code, and editable source are MIT under
[the full notice](../notices/OriginalEvergreens-MIT.txt), copyright 2026 Flight
Simulator contributors. Blender and Godot are authoring/import tools with their
own licenses; this original-art notice does not replace those licenses or grant
rights to future third-party inputs. The central license register remains
authoritative for the adopted asset leaf.

The final candidate has six explicit exports, three designs at two LODs, and an
editable Blender source with six collections and eighteen mesh children. Actual
checked geometry is 3936 triangles / 11808 stored vertices per LOD0 tree and
864 triangles / 2592 vertices per LOD1 tree. The three designs are authored at
25×5×5m, 19×9.5×9m, and 22.5×8.5×8m; these values are original art dimensions,
not measurements from a real tree or airport.

The retained evidence includes reviewed generator/checker/tool identities,
invocation and version logs, actual blend/GLB/source-receipt identities,
independent structural checks, editable-source/export comparison, and isolated
Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility import readbacks. The completed isolated proof captured
36 fixed views and six five-second approaches with 301 samples each. Approach
review used twelve derived overview sheets and selected original frames. Cropped
and resized overviews support inspection but cannot prove temporal stability or
absence of aliasing; far-range foliage aliasing and a subpixel trunk remain
documented prototype limits. Original frames and raw controls remain authoritative.
Earlier rejected art and failed proof attempts are retained separately and are not
the adopted source artifact.

The asset inventory must identify actual adopted repository-relative paths,
byte counts, and SHA256 values for the blend, six exports, source receipt,
reviewed generator/source README, verification tools, and full MIT notice.
It is not a placeholder roster or permission to fabricate unavailable hashes.
Exclude the inventory itself and record its final hash externally. Do not place
that hash in a file whose hash belongs to the same inventory, or add a receipt
self-hash; either would create a hash cycle. Local proof captures and machine
paths do not belong in the public source inventory. Parent airport, runtime,
performance, and phase acceptance gates remain separate and open.
